jobs.title: Clinical Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.why: Exceptionally close to Kevin’s current healthcare operations work: intake and care operations, playbook/SOP execution, training for launches, dashboards/KPIs, process improvement and cross-functional coordination in a scaling health-tech environment.
jobs.gap: The role asks for 4–5 years in business operations, strategy or consulting and startup operating experience. Kevin should frame his combined healthcare operations and systems/project work clearly without overstating tenure.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Vendor Implementations and Operations)
jobs.why: Strong healthcare operations/systems fit covering vendor implementations, project schedules, post-implementation operations, workflows, playbooks, process improvement, business requirements, testing, training materials, reporting and governance.
jobs.gap: Managed-care experience and Microsoft Project/Visio are specifically requested. Kevin has adjacent healthcare/Medicaid operations experience but should not present himself as having payer-side managed-care depth he has not held directly.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare AI role centered on CRM/marketing systems, data quality, automation, lead management, attribution, reporting and AI-enabled workflow improvement. It uses Kevin’s marketing background while keeping the core work operational rather than SEO-led.
jobs.gap: Pardot/Salesforce depth and direct ownership of lead-scoring/MQL lifecycle are preferred. Kevin should emphasize CRM, automation and reporting experience without implying platform expertise beyond what he has actually used.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Fresh SaaS implementation opening with direct ownership from kickoff through deployment, project plans, discovery, requirements translation, configuration, QA/UAT, client communication and training—all highly relevant to Kevin’s systems/project and training work.
jobs.gap: This is a reach because MediSpend asks for 5+ years in SaaS/high-tech implementations plus life-sciences transparency/compliance familiarity and prefers technical implementation tooling experience.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Business-systems-heavy marketing operations role owning Salesforce lifecycle workflows, routing, data quality, enrichment, automation and AI-enabled process improvement. It aligns with Kevin’s preferred CRM/workflow/reporting direction rather than SEO execution.
jobs.gap: G2 wants 5+ years specifically in Marketing Ops/RevOps/GTM systems plus deep Marketo, Salesforce, Clay and routing-stack expertise, so this is a higher technical/seniority reach.
